answer.rationale: Roll out the proven onboarding simplification rather than matching the competitor’s price cut. It improved completion, accelerated time-to-value, and increased 30-day retention; signup simplification independently produced durable SMB activation gains. Promotional pricing would address price sensitivity more directly, but the verified 12% retention decline conflicts with maximizing sustainable long-term qualified revenue. This choice supports durable growth but is not assumed to resolve immediate churn among existing price-sensitive accounts.
